final_message:
Built one policy, `AUTH-010`, in `workspace/policies/AUTH-010.xs`; it parses and the push dry run shows only `CREATE policy AUTH-010`. Confidence: medium. I did not run `xano policy evaluate` and did not push.

The policy requires login on every endpoint that reaches the `invoices` table. It is advisory, so it reports findings but does not block. It will flag `invoices/export` (`workspace/api/app/invoices/export_GET.xs`), which has no auth and returns every invoice. I did not change that endpoint, because enabling login is your decision. The check also cannot see who a login admits, whether rows are scoped by org, or paging limits.

Outputs are in `out/`: `reply.md` (plan and result), `plan.md` (the plan written before building), and `notes.json`.
